name: with-guuey-web-sample
description: platform-composed (guuey-sdk) web half of the composed golden path: a Vite SPA on @guuey/agent-client (useAgentInvoke) + @guuey/mcp-apps-host (view-mount dispatch + ui:// locator rehydration) talking to `guuey dev --serve`, mounting ggui cards through the MCP-Apps second-origin sandbox. Standalone on purpose — excluded from the repo's pnpm workspaces so its exact-pinned @guuey/* deps never share a hoist with workspace HEAD. Not published.
